sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: To further support social enterprises and, at the same time, bring their benefits to local HDB estates, HDB has partnered agencies like the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) and Singapore Centre for Social Enterprise (raiSE) to provide more support and benefits for inclusive enterprises.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: We will adjust the rental discount from 20% to 30% for three-year terms, with the option of renewing for another three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: We will also award additional points for operators who include meaningful employment for seniors aged 65 and above when bidding for HDB shops under the Price-Quality Method (PQM) framework.

sections.label: Budget meals at coffee shops
sections.summary: Budget meal requirement extends to older coffee shops due for three-yearly tenancy renewal from May 2023, covering almost half of all coffee shops and all HDB towns by 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Having seen the success of this implementation of budget meals at new rental coffee shops, we will be extending this requirement to older coffee shops due for their three-yearly tenancy renewal from May 2023 onwards.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: This will make the availability of cheaper food options in coffee shops more certain and pervasive, as coverage of the budget meal regime will be extended to almost half of all coffee shops and cover all HDB towns by 2026.

sections.label: Carpark shutter maintenance costs
sections.summary: Maintenance costs for such shutters will be borne by HDB, not the Town Councils, as they are HDB's carpark assets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Maintenance costs will be borne by HDB, not the Town Councils, as such shutters are HDB's carpark assets.

sections.label: Grants offsetting Town Council maintenance
sections.summary: The Government provides substantial grants amounting to some $239 million a year to offset Town Councils' maintenance costs so they do not fully fall on residents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: The Government also provides substantial grants, collectively amounting to some $239 million a year to offset Town Councils' costs of maintenance so that they do not fully fall on residents.

sections.label: Special funding for Town Councils
sections.summary: The Government is prepared to consider time-limited special funding support to cushion residents from the impact of Town Councils' S&CC adjustments for long-term financial sustainability.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: To support Town Councils that continue to make adjustments in S&CC to meet long-term financial sustainability, the Government is prepared to consider a time-limited, special funding support to cushion the potential impact on residents.

sections.label: Joss paper burning and illegal parking feedback
sections.summary: Feedback on irresponsible joss paper burning dropped significantly, and a Mountbatten initiative on illegal parking saw a drop in related feedback.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: After several years of annual increase, the volume of feedback received on irresponsible joss paper burning has dropped significantly for both these periods.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: One example I can think of is how we worked with the volunteers of from Mountbatten as part of the Love Our ‘Hood Initiative to tackle the issue of illegal parking.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: And this has been met with promising results, specifically, a drop in feedback about illegal parking.

sections.label: CAP quiet hours proposal
sections.summary: CAP participants accepted some daily noise but wanted more quiet, so the panel proposed extending quiet hours to 10.00 pm until 8.00 am.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Participants in the CAP’s feedback gathering exercises agreed that some amount of noise generated from daily activities was acceptable, but there was still a sense that people wished for more quiet and peaceful time to rest at home.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Thus, the panel also proposed to extend quiet hours from 10.30 pm until 7.00 am, to 10.00 pm until 8.00 am.

sections.label: MSO and CAP decibel limit study
sections.summary: MSO is working with the CAP to study adopting a decibel limit to help identify and assess egregious noise cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: MSO is also working with the CAP to study how a quantitative noise threshold in the form of a decibel limit can be adopted to aid the identification and assessment of egregious cases.

sections.label: Experiential space on reducing noise
sections.summary: Visitors can learn actions to reduce their noise impact on neighbours, with the experiential space hoped to open in the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Visitors can also look forward to learning about actions to adopt to effectively reduce their noise impact on their neighbours.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: We hope to open this experiential space to the public in the second half of this year.

sections.label: Neighbourhood noise remains elevated
sections.summary: Case volumes have receded to pre-COVID-19 levels except neighbourhood noise, which remains significantly elevated.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Since then, case volumes have receded to pre-COVID-19 levels with the exception of neighbourhood noise, which remains significantly elevated.

sections.label: Pilot of dedicated personnel unit
sections.summary: Recognising instances where Government intervention would make a difference, a unit of dedicated personnel will be piloted.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: But we recognise instances where some Government intervention would make a difference.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: We will, therefore, pilot a unit of dedicated personnel.

sections.label: Heartland shop upgrading co-funding
sections.summary: HDB increases co-funding for heartland shop upgrading, with shop owners paying 5% of costs and 80% co-funding for shop front works up to $3,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: First, to support small businesses, HDB will increase the co-funding support for heartland shop owners undergoing upgrading works under the Revitalisation of Shops scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: Shop owners will only need to pay 5% of the upgrading costs, down from the current 20%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: We will also provide new co-funding support for works at shop fronts, for example, installing roller-shutters or more lighting.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: We will co-fund 80% of these works, up to a cap of $3,000.

sections.label: Coffeeshop budget meals requirement
sections.summary: From May, coffeeshops due for tenancy renewal must provide four budget meals and two budget drinks, and by 2026 every town will have at least one such coffeeshop.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: From May this year, we will require coffeeshops that are due for tenancy renewal to provide four budget meals and two budget drinks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann)
sentences.text: By 2026, every town will have at least one coffeeshop providing cooked food at budget prices.

sections.label: BCA construction demand estimate
sections.summary: For this year, BCA estimates total construction demand will be between $27 billion and $32 billion.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: For this year, the Building and Construction Authority (BCA) estimates that the total construction demand will be between $27 billion and $32 billion.

sections.label: HDB site productivity target
sections.summary: By 2030, HDB intends a 40% improvement in site productivity over 2010 levels, piloting initiatives at Tengah Garden Waterfront I and II.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: By 2030, HDB intends to achieve an overall 40% improvement in site productivity compared to its 2010 levels, which means, new flats get built faster, benefiting more Singaporeans earlier.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: To achieve this ambitious goal, HDB will pilot new initiatives via its Construction Transformation Project at Tengah Garden Waterfront I and II.

sections.label: IDD adoption in new developments
sections.summary: In 2022, 45% of new developments by Gross Floor Area adopted IDD, on track for 70% adoption by 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: In 2022, 45% of all new developments by Gross Floor Area adopted IDD and we are on track to meet our target of 70% adoption by 2025.

sections.label: SME digital solutions funding
sections.summary: This new tranche provides SMEs funding support of up to 50% of qualifying costs in adopting pre-approved digital solutions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: This has reduced their administrative workload and minimised human errors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: This new tranche provides SMEs with funding support of up to 50% of the qualifying costs in adopting pre-approved digital solutions.

sections.label: New building submission regulatory process
sections.summary: A new regulatory process for building submissions streamlines over 20 agency touchpoints into three submission gateways.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: This is why we have been working with industry and agencies to develop a new regulatory process for building submissions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: This new process streamlines more than 20 existing touchpoints with agencies into three key submission gateways.

sections.label: CORENET X approval time savings
sections.summary: CORENET X could preliminarily cut approval time by 20% to 25%, saving four to five months of manpower.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Preliminarily, CORENET X could reduce the time for a firm to obtain approvals across the development process by 20% to 25%, which translates to an overall four to five months' worth of manpower savings – very significant.

sections.label: DfMA adoption and Investment Allowance Scheme
sections.summary: DfMA adoption rose from 44% in 2021 to 51% in 2022, and the Investment Allowance Scheme is extended to 2028.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Residents in surrounding areas also benefit as less noise and dust is generated.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: I am pleased to share that the DfMA adoption rate for all new developments by GFA has increased from 44% in 2021 to 51% in 2022 and we are on track to meeting our target of 70% by 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: To further support firms' productivity efforts, we will extend the Investment Allowance Scheme (IAS) for the construction industry for another five years, till 2028.

sections.label: Minimum capital expenditure per application
sections.summary: The minimum capital expenditure value per application is raised to $1 million to encourage redesigned work processes and integrated systems.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Like Sam Lain, to achieve greater productive improvement, firms will need more fundamental redesigned work processes across multiple tasks and to make use of integrated systems instead of just a single machinery.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Therefore, we have decided to raise the minimum capital expenditure value per application to $1 million to encourage firms to do so.

sections.label: Singapore Green Building Masterplan targets
sections.summary: Under the Singapore Green Building Masterplan, three 80-80-80 in 2030 targets are on track, with greening and energy efficiency progress.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Under the latest edition of the Singapore Green Building Masterplan, we set out three ambitious targets, or "80-80-80 in 2030".

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: With the hard work of industry partners, we are on track to meet these targets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We have greened close to 55% of our buildings, seen about 20% of our new buildings in the past year achieve Super Low Energy standards and achieved over 70% improvement in energy efficiency over 2005 levels for our best-in-class buildings.

sections.label: Mandatory Energy Improvement regime
sections.summary: A Mandatory Energy Improvement regime will be introduced by end-2024, requiring owners of poorly performing buildings to audit and reduce energy consumption.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: However, there is currently no requirement for building owners to improve their buildings' energy performance if they do not undertake such works.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: This is why we will introduce a new Mandatory Energy Improvement, or MEI regime by the end of 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We will require the owners of buildings with poor energy performance to conduct an energy audit and implement measures to reduce energy consumption.

sections.label: Energy-intensive buildings regime coverage
sections.summary: The regime will apply to the most energy-intensive commercial buildings, healthcare facilities, sports and recreation centres and institutional buildings with a Gross Floor Area of 5,000 square metres and above.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: For a start, the regime will apply to the most energy-intensive commercial buildings, healthcare facilities, sports and recreation centres and institutional buildings with a Gross Floor Area of 5,000 square metres and above.

sections.label: Variation Order and account timelines
sections.summary: Agencies should certify the valuation of the Variation Order within 60 days of the completion of VO works and finalise the account within 30 days after the Defects Liability Period.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: For instance, agencies should certify the valuation of the Variation Order, or VO within 60 days of the completion of VO works and not the completion of the overall project.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Agencies also should finalise the account within 30 days after the Defects Liability Period.

sections.label: Growth and Transformation Scheme alliances
sections.summary: The alliance is supported by the Growth and Transformation Scheme, under which $90 million has been set aside to help establish alliances between developers, builders, consultants and other stakeholders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: This is one of the alliances being supported by the Growth and Transformation Scheme, or GTS, which Minister Desmond Lee spoke about at the Committee of Supply two years ago.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We have set aside $90 million under the GTS to help establish alliances between developers, builders, consultants and other stakeholders.

sections.label: SME and construction industry support extensions
sections.summary: BCA will extend the Productivity Solutions Grant with a new $21 million tranche for another three years, and extend the Investment Allowance Scheme for the construction industry for another five years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Second, to continue to support the digital transformation of SMEs, BCA will extend the Productivity Solutions Grant, with a new $21 million tranche, for another three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Third, we will also extend the Investment Allowance Scheme for the construction industry for another five years.

sections.label: Our Wild Neighbours outreach initiative
sections.summary: Last April, UWG members launched the "Our Wild Neighbours" initiative, a country-wide outreach programme to raise public awareness of Singapore's native wildlife.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Last April, the UWG members launched the "Our Wild Neighbours" initiative – a country-wide outreach programme to raise public awareness of Singapore's native wildlife.

sections.label: Enforcement against bird-feeding cases
sections.summary: Over the past two years, enforcement action was taken against more than a hundred cases of bird-feeding each year, ranging from warnings to prosecution for more serious cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Over the past two years, we have taken enforcement action against more than a hundred cases of bird-feeding each year, with actions ranging from warnings to prosecution for more serious cases.

sections.label: Reviewing Animals and Birds Act
sections.summary: The Animals and Birds Act is being reviewed, including possibly enhancing penalties for animal cruelty and abuse.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: To further strengthen our safeguards on animal health and welfare, as well as public health and safety, we are reviewing the Animals and Birds Act, including the possibility of enhancing penalties for animal cruelty and abuse.

sections.label: Pet cat licensing and microchipping
sections.summary: A licensing and microchipping scheme for pet cats is being considered, with a public survey drawing over 30,000 responses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: One of the components being considered is a licensing and microchipping scheme for pet cats.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Since last September, we have been consulting extensively on this framework.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: We are heartened to have received a strong response to our public survey, which garnered more than 30,000 responses.

sections.label: Singapore fighting illegal wildlife trade
sections.summary: Singapore was recognised at the 2021 United Nations Asia Environmental Enforcement Awards for intercepting illegal elephant ivory trade.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: Singapore is committed to the global fight against illegal wildlife trade.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: At the 2021 United Nations Asia Environmental Enforcement Awards, we were recognised for our contributions in intercepting the illegal trade of elephant ivory.

sections.label: CITES and wildlife trade enforcement
sections.summary: CITES is the only UN convention regulating endangered species trade, and NParks will work with counterparts and organisations like CITES and INTERPOL.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: While I can fully appreciate the spirit behind the suggestion, it will neither be feasible nor effective for us to do so as we cannot unilaterally impose such an approach on the rest of the world.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: CITES is currently the only international convention under the United Nations that regulates the trade of endangered species and almost all countries have signed up to this.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
sentences.text: NParks will continue to work closely with counterparts in source and destination countries and share information with international organisations, like CITES and INTERPOL, to assist in their further investigations and enforcement.

sections.label: Affordable housing for all Singaporeans
sections.summary: The commitment to affordable and accessible housing is for all Singaporeans, including lower-income households.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Our commitment to provide affordable and accessible housing is for all Singaporeans, including lower-income households.

sections.label: Reduced average waiting time
sections.summary: These efforts have reduced the average waiting time to about six months currently.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: As a result of these efforts, we have reduced the average waiting time to about six months currently.

sections.label: ComLink Rental Scheme launch
sections.summary: The ComLink Rental Scheme was launched in November last year with MSF to pair rental housing with holistic support for families with children.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: As part of this effort, we worked with MSF to launch the ComLink Rental Scheme in November last year to pair rental housing with holistic support for families with children.

sections.label: ComLink families engaged
sections.summary: As of end-January 2023, ComLink officers have engaged over 130 families under this scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: As of end-January 2023, ComLink officers have engaged over 130 families under this scheme.

sections.label: Household housing readiness status
sections.summary: About 370 households are ready to apply for a flat in one to two years, about 100 are waiting for completion, and about 60 have collected keys.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Among them, about 370 households are assessed to be ready to apply for a flat in the next one to two years, about 100 households are waiting for their new home to be completed, and about 60 households have collected the keys to their new home.

sections.label: Fresh Start Housing Scheme enhancements
sections.summary: The Fresh Start Housing Scheme was enhanced last year with a $50,000 grant, 3-room flats with shorter leases, and 7,800 households progressed to home ownership in 10 years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: To provide more help to such second-timer families with children, we enhanced the Fresh Start Housing Scheme last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: We increased the grant to $50,000 to boost their housing budget.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: In addition to 2-room Flexi flats, starting from the ongoing February BTO sales exercise, Fresh Start families can also buy 3-room flats with a shorter lease, which will be more affordable.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: In the past 10 years, 7,800 households who stayed in public rental housing have progressed to home ownership.

sections.label: Divorcing parties flat application rules
sections.summary: Since March 2019, HDB allows divorcing parties with Interim Judgment and resolved ancillary matters to apply for a flat without selling their matrimonial flat first, with up to six months to sell after collecting keys.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Since March 2019, HDB allows divorcing parties who have not finalised their divorce to apply for a flat from HDB, once they have obtained the Interim Judgment of divorce and resolved the ancillary matters relating to the matrimonial property and the custody, care and control of their children.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Divorcing parties also do not need to wait until their matrimonial flat is sold before applying for a new flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: They are given up to six months after collecting the keys to their new flats to sell their matrimonial flat, which is generally sufficient for flat owners.

sections.label: Third CCA site launch
sections.summary: A third CCA site will be launched later this year in Bedok, as Minister Desmond Lee shared earlier.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: As Minister Desmond Lee shared earlier, we will be launching a third CCA site later this year in Bedok.

sections.label: LBS and SHB take-up
sections.summary: About 9,700 households took up the LBS and more than 1,500 households benefited from the SHB.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: About 9,700 households have taken up the LBS, and more than 1,500 households have benefited from the SHB.

sections.label: New first-timer priority category
sections.summary: A new priority category, First-Timer (Parents & Married Couples), will be introduced for first-timer families with children aged 18 and below and young married couples aged 40 and below.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: So we will do even more to help first-timer applicant families with children aged 18 and below, and young married couples aged 40 and below.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: We will introduce a new priority category, which we will call First-Timer (Parents & Married Couples).

sections.label: Extra ballot and flat supply
sections.summary: First-timers get one more ballot, the Parenthood Priority Scheme is expanded to all First-Timer Parents and Married Couples, and set-aside supply rises to 40% of BTO and up to 60% of balance flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: First, they will receive one more ballot, up from the two ballots that first-timers currently get, when they apply for any flat type in any estate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Second, we will expand the existing Parenthood Priority Scheme so that all First-Timer Parents and Married Couples also qualify.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: We will increase the supply of 3-room and larger flats that we set aside for them by another 10 percentage points to 40% of the BTO flat supply and up to 60% of the supply of balance flats.

sections.label: Pilot expansion to three sites
sections.summary: Given the positive response, the pilot program will be expanded to three new sites.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Given the positive response, we will expand this pilot program to three new sites.

sections.label: Family and Parenthood Priority Scheme
sections.summary: The Parenthood Priority Scheme is renamed the Family and Parenthood Priority Scheme, adding married couples in the First-Timer Parents and Married Couples group, with set-aside supply raised from 30% to 40%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Of the three measures that we are undertaking – the Member asked about the Parenthood Priority Scheme, which is now renamed as the Family and Parenthood Priority Scheme (FPTS) – because in addition to couples with children or expecting children, we are also putting in married couples who would be part of the First-Timer Parents and Married Couples group.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: And in view of this, we are expanding the proportion of flat supply that we set aside for this group which would include the group formally benefiting under the Parenthood Priority Scheme, from 30% to 40% and through that, we seek to strike a balance ensuring that this group, the young married couples and parents, get extra support while also ensuring that first-timers under the PPS continue also to benefit as first-timers.

sections.label: No $1,500 income ceiling
sections.summary: There is no income ceiling of $1,500, and in 2022, 27% of approved applications were from applicants earning more than $1,500.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Like what I have shared earlier, there is no income ceiling of $1,500.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We have approved cases where the proposed tenants or the applicants earned more than $1,500.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For example, in 2022 alone, 27% of the applications we approved were for those applicants having an income of more than $1,500.

sections.label: Income and housing budget
sections.summary: Income is used to assess housing budget and option, and applicants are not accepted or rejected based purely on income.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, your income will be used to assess your housing budget and option.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I quote, "we do not reject or accept applicants based purely on income.

sections.label: BTO flat launch pipeline
sections.summary: Between 2021 and 2025, up to 100,000 BTO flats are planned, with over 100 projects and 80,000 flats being built now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As I have said, between 2021 and 2025, we plan to launch up to 100,000 BTO flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: That is a pipeline that requires a number of years of work beforehand in order to identify the land, in order to identify the things that need to be done, in order to make the land ready for that.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We have over 100 projects ongoing as we speak, 80,000 flats being built at this very moment.

sections.label: Subsidised PPHS flats for lower-income
sections.summary: Focus is on ramping up PPHS flats, helping lower-income households earning $7,000 and below with subsidised PPHS flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: At this point in time, we are focused on ramping up the PPHS flats, helping those from lower-income households, the $7,000 and below, with subsidised PPHS flats.

sections.label: Private property owners renting HDB flats
sections.summary: Half of home owners who own private properties while being HDB flat owners rent out their HDB flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Of the home owners who own private properties while being HDB flat owners, half of this group rent out their HDB flat.

sections.label: Flat configurations and hybrid work study
sections.summary: HDB is studying different configurations for flat typologies, including small workspace options, and the lasting legacy of COVID-19 for hybrid work.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But, all in, push the structural elements to the outer perimeters of the flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But going further, HDB is studying whether it would be useful to give different configurations for the same flat typologies: 5-room, 4-room, 3-room.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But instead of having the typical standard kind of room configurations, to allow some options, including providing options for people to configure a small workspace if necessary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But beyond that, as part of the Long-Term Plan Review, we are studying the lasting legacy of our COVID-19 experience in terms of how Singaporeans and how our enterprises are adjusting and providing for hybrid work.

sections.label: Alternative uses for car park space
sections.summary: For multi-storey car parks, unutilised space can have alternative uses.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: For multi-storey car parks, we do have, where there is unutilised space, it is possible to have alternative uses.

sections.label: HDB coffee shop affordability
sections.summary: Budget Meal Regime will expand to HDB-leased coffee shops, and operators of sold coffee shops will be engaged on affordable food concerns.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Coffee shops that are in HDB estates are either owned by HDB and leased out, or they are sold coffee shops.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: I have explained that for the coffee shops that are leased out by HDB, our intention is to expand the Budget Meal Regime to all of them, and I believe that will make an impact, in terms of ensuring that there are affordable options in these coffee shops.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: As for the sold coffee shops, I have also explained just now, that we have already decided to engage operators, those coffee shop chains that are operating out of this sold coffee shops, to explain to them MND's concerns about the availability of affordable food.

sections.label: Pilot Courier Hub car parks
sections.summary: The Pilot Courier Hub for delivery drivers handling high-volume parcels is rolled out at two HDB car parks in Punggol and Buangkok.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: I think this was reported back on 4 November 2021, where it said that delivery drivers who are handling high-volume parcels were doing a pilot.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: It is called the Pilot Courier Hub and it is being rolled out at two HDB car parks in Punggol and in Buangkok.

sections.label: Collaborative contracting pilot projects
sections.summary: Agencies including HDB and other significant GPEs will pilot collaborative contracting, with at least 10 public sector projects piloting it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: Agencies, not just HDB, but the other significant GPEs will be piloting the collaborative contracting approach.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: I mentioned earlier, that at least 10 public sector projects have piloted or will be piloting this approach.

sections.label: Sustainability in public sector tenders
sections.summary: From 2024 environmental sustainability will be incorporated in public sector tenders, piloted with construction tenders of at least $50 million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) and Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment (MSE) COS have announced earlier that environmental sustainability considerations will be incorporated in the public sector tenders and evaluation processes, starting from 2024.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: This will be piloted with construction tenders, with a minimum estimated procurement value of $50 million and their associated consultancy tenders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: At the construction stage, GPEs are required to commit to a 25% to 30% site productivity improvement over the 2010 levels, by 2025, for construction projects.

sections.label: CCA Basic Service Package opt-out
sections.summary: A question asks whether Community Care Apartment residents can opt out of the Basic Service Package costing about $164 plus GST monthly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
sentences.text: For Minister of State Faishal, can the Community Care Apartment (CCA) residents be allowed to opt out of this Basic Service Package, which I understand costs about $164, plus GST per month?

sections.label: CCA residents cannot opt out
sections.summary: Other options are provided for seniors, but Community Care Apartment residents cannot opt out of the Basic Service Package.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: As you can see, we also provide other options available to the seniors, so they can choose whichever options they are comfortable with.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, with regards to the Community Care Apartment (CCA), they cannot opt out.

sections.label: Stair lifts technical feasibility
sections.summary: MND previously found stair lifts technically not feasible, but the government is open to exploring a safe technical solution.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: And I recall that many years ago, I had asked MND to look into this, which they did, and technically, it was not feasible, given the stair lifts at that time.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, if there is a good technical solution, making sure that safety is not compromised and that it actually does address the problem, I think we would be open to explore it.

sections.label: Managing human-wildlife conflicts
sections.summary: The government will explore ways to better manage human-wildlife conflicts, including reducing food sources in human-inhabited areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The short answer to the Member's suggestions is yes, we certainly will explore all the different ways in which you can better manage the human-wildlife conflicts, including being more proactive about looking at the habitats of the wildlife and at the specific areas where there are food sources, and how we can make sure we minimise the food source available to them, so that they can stop foraging at the human-inhabited areas.

sections.label: MND public housing expenditure
sections.summary: MND's public housing development expenditure rose from $2.9 billion in fiscal 2021 to $7.2 billion in fiscal 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: First question, MND's expenditure on public housing development has already ballooned from $2.9 billion in fiscal year 2021 to $7.2 billion in fiscal year 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
sentences.text: And this is mainly due to the difference between the rising land cost that goes into the reserves and what is collected from the BTO buyers.

sections.label: Construction costs and property market
sections.summary: Construction costs rose 30% amid complex building conditions, and the government is committed to managing supply-demand distortion in the property market.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We are building a lot more in areas where building is more complicated – for example, soil conditions, slopes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We are building taller buildings and more comprehensive estates Construction costs have gone up by 30%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong had said in the Budget debate, we are in that part of the property cycle where we are dealing with imbalance in supply and demand, resulting in greater demand as well as higher resale prices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: We are committed to manage this supply-demand distortion in order to bring the property market to a more stable ground.
